prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a hit while turning left. The patient had 10 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1119; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck from the side while completing a left turn. The patient reported immediate onset of neck pain, stiffness, and headache, with pain radiating into the right trapezius region. Examination revealed restricted cervical range of motion, particularly with rotation and extension, along with paraspinal muscle tenderness and mild muscle guarding. Neurological screening was within normal limits, with no motor deficits or reflex changes. Imaging was not indicated at initial evaluation given the absence of red-flag findings.

Treatment over the course of ten visits included manual therapy to the cervical spine and upper thoracic region, soft tissue mobilization, progressive therapeutic exercise for cervical stabilization, and home exercise instruction. The patient was also counseled on activity modification and ergonomic posture. Pain and range of motion improved steadily across visits, with the patient reporting significant reduction in headache frequency by the final visit. At discharge, the patient demonstrated near-full cervical range of motion with residual mild stiffness on end-range rotation. Ongoing self-directed home exercise was recommended, with follow-up as needed should symptoms recur.
